title: Higher usage limits for Claude and a compute deal with SpaceX
summary: Anthropic宣布与SpaceX达成计算合作，获得Colossus 1数据中心全部算力，同时将Claude的5小时使用限额翻倍。此举直接缓解了因用户激增导致的算力瓶颈，并显著提升付费用户体验。合作凸显了顶级AI公司对算力的饥渴，以及跨界资源整合的新趋势。

title: GPT-5.5 Instant
raw_excerpt: OpenAI released GPT5.5 Instant, updating its default ChatGPT model with improved factual accuracy, reduced hallucinations, and stronger personalization based on user context.
summary: OpenAI发布GPT-5.5 Instant，作为ChatGPT默认模型更新，重点提升事实准确性、减少幻觉，并基于用户上下文增强个性化。该模型在多项基准上表现优异，进一步巩固了OpenAI在对话AI领域的领先地位，同时为开发者提供了更可靠的推理基础。

title: The context window has been shattered: Subquadratic debuts a 12-million-token window
raw_excerpt: Subquadratic has launched a new AI model with a 12-million-token context window. It outperforms GPT-5.5 on retrieval benchmarks. Attention cost scales quadratically with context length, so doubling the input quadruples the work. Subquadratic claims to have solved the problem. It plans to offer a model with a 50-million-token context window soon.
summary: 初创公司Subquadratic发布支持1200万token上下文窗口的AI模型，在检索基准上超越GPT-5.5。其核心创新在于解决了注意力机制随上下文长度二次方增长的计算瓶颈，并计划推出5000万token窗口版本。这一突破将极大扩展长文档分析、代码库理解等应用场景。

Google first revealed Project Mariner in December 2024 and later announced an update allowing it to perform up to 10 tasks at a time. title: Accelerating Gemma 4: faster inference with multi-token prediction drafters
raw_excerpt: Gemma 4 models reduce latency bottlenecks and achieve improved responsiveness for developers by using Multi-Token Prediction drafters. These drafters deliver up to a 3x speedup without any degradation in output quality or reasoning logic due to a specialized speculative decoding architecture. Speculative decoding decouples token generation from verification. It utilizes idle compute to 'predict' several future tokens at once with the drafter in less time than it takes for the target model to process just one token. The target model then verifies all of these suggested tokens in parallel.
summary: 谷歌发布Gemma 4模型的多token预测草稿器，通过投机解码架构实现高达3倍的推理加速，且不牺牲输出质量。该技术利用空闲计算资源并行预测多个未来token，再由主模型验证，显著降低了延迟。这对于需要实时响应的应用场景具有重要意义。

title: Google’s AI search summaries will now quote Reddit

One of the more notable changes introduces "a preview of perspectives" from firsthand sources like social media, Reddit, and other web forums, effectively linking your search queries with online conversations around similar topics. Google says this update aims to address that "people are increasingly seeking out advice from others" when searching for information online. This will be relatable for anyone who's added "Reddit" to the end of Google Search terms to find experiences from real humans instead of SEO-optimized  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 谷歌更新AI搜索功能，新增“观点预览”模块，可直接引用Reddit等社交平台和论坛的一手经验。该功能旨在满足用户对真实人类反馈的需求，将搜索结果与在线讨论连接起来。此举提升了搜索结果的实用性和可信度，但也可能引发内容版权和质量的讨论。

title: Chrome’s AI features may be hogging 4GB of your computer storage
raw_excerpt: Google Chrome may be taking up more of your storage than expected thanks to a large on-device AI model file that, in some cases, is being automatically downloaded to the browser's system folders. Users who have noticed unexplained drops in their available desktop device storage are now discovering that Chrome is installing a 4GB weights.bin file inside their browser directory when certain AI features are enabled. The weights.bin file in question is connected to Google's Gemini Nano AI model , which powers Chrome AI tools like scam detection, writing assistance, autofill, and suggestion features. summary: 用户发现谷歌Chrome浏览器在启用AI功能时，会自动下载约4GB的Gemini Nano模型文件，导致存储空间异常减少。该模型用于本地AI功能如诈骗检测、写作辅助等。此事引发了对用户知情权和存储管理的关注，也凸显了本地AI模型部署的存储成本问题。

title: AI2 Released MolmoAct 2
raw_excerpt: MolmoAct 2 is an upgraded action reasoning model that improves real-world robot task performance and is paired with a large open bimanual manipulation dataset.
summary: AI2发布MolmoAct 2，一个升级的动作推理模型，可提升真实世界机器人任务的表现。同时配套发布了大规模双臂操作数据集。该工作为机器人学习和具身智能提供了更强大的基础模型和数据资源，有助于推动机器人从实验室走向实际应用。

title: Gemini API File Search is now multimodal: build efficient, verifiable RAG
raw_excerpt: Multimodal support, custom metadata filtering, and page-level citations are now available in the Gemini API File Search tool. The features can help developers bring structure to unstructured data for efficient, verifiable RAG. Users' RAG systems can now natively process and better organize text and visual data. The File Search tool handles the heavy infrastructure so users can focus on building products.
summary: 谷歌Gemini API的File Search工具新增多模态支持、自定义元数据过滤和页面级引用功能，使开发者能够构建更高效、可验证的RAG系统。该工具原生处理文本和视觉数据，并自动管理基础设施，降低了构建检索增强生成应用的门槛。
